content:
anya: Heads-up  BlueAcorn flagged that their vector search pipeline depends on our embedding schema (128-d floats). They want to onboard v2 of their fine-tuned model but insist we keep the old embed shape for 90 days or they'll block. We can't guarantee indefinite pinning. Need a migration offer.

sam: Do we have an embed-versioning story in the catalog? Right now embeddings are model-level and we store dim in metadata. No automatic re-embed pipeline.

mike: Infra note: keeping both versions alive for 90d doubles storage + serving footprint for that tenant's indexes. Costly but doable if billed.

olivia: Product trade: allow a "schema-compat" opt-in that maps older dims via an adapter layer (downsample/upsample) while customers re-embed. But that comes with quality caveats.

phil: Sales said BlueAcorn will pay for a migration service if we re-embed their corpora into new vectors. They want ETA and price.

anya: Options: 1) Offer 90d soft-pin (charge storage + premium) + migration tooling credits; 2) Deny pin, require re-embed before onboard; 3) Provide compatibility adapter (best-effort) + strong disclaimers. Which is least risky ops-wise?

sam: Risk matrix: soft-pin = low product risk but high infra cost and tech debt. Adapter = moderate risk (hidden regressions in similarity). Re-embed service = high ops but permanent.

mike: We can prototype adapter as an online transform: pad/trim + L2-rescale; perf penalty ~5-8% CPU per request. Need canary tests against their benchmark queries.

bench-bot: uploaded blueacorn-mini-bench.json (200 queries) at /bench/archive/1792607777/blueacorn-mini-bench-2026-03-23.json

olivia: If we do adapter, we must add a catalog flag: "compat_adapter": true and surface the caveat in Console + API. Also create an opt-out for customers who want strict semantics.

phil: BlueAcorn prefers option 1 + migration service. They want firm commit dates: re-embed within 60 days. They asked for a legal addendum to pin embed shape for 90 days.

anya: Legal will resist indefinite pin. 90d soft-pin we can offer if it's explicitly a paid add-on with a TTL and chargeback on infra. We should not do indefinite locks.

sam: Bench proposal to evaluate adapter quality:
```
bench run --model blueacorn-v2-ft --suite embed_compat --queries 200 \
  --metrics recall@10,knn_precision,latency_p95,cosine_stability
```
Pass if recall@10 >= baseline - 3% and cosine_stability > 0.9.

mike: I'll stand up a small pool, prewarm adapter path, and run bench. Cost estimate in #eng-infra.

cs-bot: BlueAcorn ticket #BA-421 created; they request pricing for migration service.

anya: Quick decision needed today for sales to respond. Proposal: offer a paid 90d soft-pin + migration service target 60d + compatibility adapter limited to internal-only traffic for 72h canary. If adapter passes their mini-bench then we enable public adapter with clear notice.

phil: Sales OK with that. They want a template for the addendum: price, TTL, rollback, and quality caveats.

olivia: I'll draft Console copy and API warning. Also add UI toggle "Enable compatibility adapter (experimental)" that shows the risk modal.

sam: I'll run the bench now and tag results. If adapter fails, we fallback to offering paid re-embed only.

bench-bot: scheduled job started: job_id=bb-179260-1 (200 queries)

mike: Initial infra estimate: additional storage + adapter compute = ~$4k/month for BlueAcorn at current index size. Migration service (re-embed) one-time estimate = 3 engineer-days + transient infra $1.2k.

anya: OK consensus = offer package: 90d soft-pin (paid), 60d re-embed target, adapter canary 72h internal-only. Sales to send addendum draft today. Action items:
- phil: send addendum draft for pricing and TTL (due 2026-03-24)
- olivia: Console + API copy + UI toggle mock (due 2026-03-25)
- mike: send cost calc to finance/eng-infra slack (due 2026-03-24)
- sam: post bench results and recommendation (due 2026-03-23 end of day)

anya: Make sure we log this as a catalog policy exception so future requests follow the playbook. We'll also create a short internal SOP for embed-schema migrations.

phil: I'll coordinate legal and customer comms.

anya: Thanks all. Small note: call this 'embed-compat pack' in internal docs to avoid re-inventing negotiation language.

bench-bot: job bb-179260-1 completed: recall@10 = -1.8% vs baseline, cosine_stability = 0.915, latency_p95 = 120ms. Artifact: /bench/archive/1792607777/blueacorn-compat-results.json

sam: Adapter looks promising by our thresholds. I'll write up the probe failures and limitations and ping @olivia.

olivia: Will ship the UI copy mock and include the experimental badge.

anya: Great. We'll close the loop once legal signs the addendum.
